Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-07-24 21:38 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors track global risk appetite and real yield differentials; their strength typically signals a "risk-on" environment that favors high-beta EM currencies like BRL. The -8.4% residual indicates USDBRL is trading significantly below its factor-implied fair value, suggesting the Real is fundamentally overvalued or the market is pricing in idiosyncratic bullishness not captured by global equity styles. This divergence implies a potential mean-reversion catalyst toward 5.5386 if risk premiums normalize.
